ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens (dark green and light green leaves, some wilted, a few small white crumbles of cheese scattered on top, a pale green stem visible) piled in the center-left of a white plate, roughly 40% of plate footprint, about 4-5 cm tall, moist with slight dressing sheen | 90
ITEM 2 | Sliced cucumber rounds (pale green with white edges, thin slices about 0.5 cm thick) and dark purple-black olives (whole, glossy, some halved) clustered at upper right of the plate, next to thinly sliced red onion rings and diced red pepper pieces | 45
ITEM 3 | Rectangular flatbread-style slice (about 6 x 4 cm, 1.5 cm thick) at lower left, golden-brown with charred blisters, topped with melted white cheese and red tomato sauce showing through, firm and slightly crisp edges | 55
ITEM 4 | Rectangular flatbread-style slice (about 6 x 4 cm, 1.5 cm thick) at bottom center, golden-brown with dark charred spots, melted white cheese with red tomato pieces visible, slightly soft interior | 55
ITEM 5 | Rectangular flatbread-style slice (about 6 x 5 cm, 1.5 cm thick) at lower right, heavily browned and blistered top with dark char marks, melted cheese and tomato layer, crisp edges | 60
ITEM 6 | Dressing or oil residue (thin, glossy sheen) lightly coating the leaves and vegetables, with small flecks of dark seasoning | 5
